meta.name: Adrishyam The Invisible Heroes
meta.description: Always around but never seen, these unsung protectors of the nation are continuously working towards India’s protection behind the façade of being common folks. Starring Divyanka Tripathi and Eijaz Khan, ‘Adrishyam – The Invisible Heroes’ is the story of IB47, a premier intelligence agency in India whose members are fighting the never-ending war on terror and protecting the nation while balancing their personal lives and keeping their identities secret.

videos.title: Operation Sayra - Chapter 1
videos.overview: Ravi and Parvati investigate the case of an elusive terrorist named Begum. However, they struggle to balance their personal lives and their duty to protect the nation from behind the shadows.

videos.title: Operation Sayra - Chapter 2
videos.overview: Ravi and Parvati learn that their prime suspect, Abdul, and his brother, have been killed in jail. Now, their only lead is Abdul's widow, Benazir. Will they find the answers they are looking for?

videos.title: Operation Sayra - Chapter 3
videos.overview: Ravi is scrambling for leads after his spy, Sayra, gets compromised. Meanwhile, three young terrorists arrive in Mumbai to plan their attack.

videos.title: Operation Sayra - Chapter 4
videos.overview: Parvati strikes a deal with Vikram to gather more information. Ravi and his team learn about the terrorists' plans to detonate a human bomb during a marathon event. Can their plan be stopped?

videos.title: Operation Nishabd - Chapter 1
videos.overview: Ravi decides to tell his wife the truth about his job to save their marriage. Meanwhile, Parvati interrogates a terror operative to find out about their plans in Mumbai.

videos.title: Operation Nishabd - Chapter 2
videos.overview: Ravi finds out that his wife wants a divorce from him. Meanwhile, the agency takes help from Captain Joshi to catch the terrorist who was trying to scam him.

videos.title: Operation Nishabd - Chapter 3
videos.overview: Arjun gets abducted by the terrorist group, and the agency tries their best to free him. Meanwhile, Ravi makes an effort to save his marriage.

videos.title: Operation Nishabd - Chapter 4
videos.overview: The agency learns that the terrorists are planning an attack with a bioweapon. Meanwhile, Parvati searches for her daughter, who goes missing from home.

videos.title: Operation Siyasat - Chapter 1
videos.overview: Ravi gets injured in a shootout and is forced out of action indefinitely. Meanwhile, an insurgent named Nola is freed from jail due to a lack of evidence against him.

videos.title: Operation Siyasat - Chapter 2
videos.overview: When Nola turns up dead soon after Parvati coaxes a confession, an agency operative named Asha is blamed for poisoning him. What will Parvati and the others do now?

videos.title: Operation Siyasat - Chapter 3
videos.overview: Vikram tries to turn Parvati's daughter against her. Meanwhile, Ravi and his team conduct a raid at one of the insurgent safe houses.

videos.title: Operation Siyasat - Chapter 4
videos.overview: Political leader Nana Saheb mysteriously turns up dead, and Ravi's team loses their lead. Meanwhile, Arjun's cover is blown when the insurgents find the hidden cameras.

videos.title: Operation Jawab - Chapter 1
videos.overview: The agency gets information that terrorists are planning to break out their leader, Tarik Malik, from prison. Will Ravi and Parvati be able to stop their plans?

videos.title: Operation Jawab - Chapter 2
videos.overview: Ravi and his team spoil the terrorist mission and bring Tarik Malik to a secure location. Meanwhile, Vikram sends divorce papers to Parvati and wants to claim their daughter's custody.

videos.title: Operation Jawab - Chapter 3
videos.overview: Vikram takes Khushi on a trip without informing Parvati. Meanwhile, Ravi and his team get a lead to catch a terrorist operative named Abu Azam.

videos.title: Operation Jawab - Chapter 4
videos.overview: The agency is scrambling after a series of bomb blasts across the city. Will Ravi and Parvati be able to get ahead of the situation?

videos.title: Operation Qurbani - Chapter 1
videos.overview: A terrorist group gets into a shootout with the crime branch. Parvati interrogates the captain of the crime branch, Praveen Tawde, about the intentions behind the unsanctioned encounter.

videos.title: Operation Qurbani - Chapter 2
videos.overview: Ravi, Parvati and the agency come under immense pressure after the bomb blast at the police station. How will they deal with this situation?

videos.title: Operation Qurbani - Chapter 3
videos.overview: The young terrorist slits her wrist while under Ravi and Parvati's custody, and she is taken to the hospital. Meanwhile, Vikram tries to come back into Khushi's life.

videos.title: Operation Qurbani - Chapter 4
videos.overview: The agency operatives raid a beauty parlour to catch the terrorist soldiers hiding there. Parvati and his team interrogate the terrorists and learn about Begum's plan.

videos.title: Operation Tabaahi - Chapter 1
videos.overview: Parvati is worried about Vikram as the doctors work to save him. Meanwhile, Ravi asks his team to increase the security for the family members of BIA operatives.

videos.title: Operation Tabaahi - Chapter 2
videos.overview: Parvati and her team neutralize all the terrorists in the shootout. Meanwhile, Ravi's undercover operation hits a snag when their target is found dead in a bathroom.

videos.title: Operation Tabaahi - Chapter 3
videos.overview: The news of Ajay Sinha's murder in broad daylight spreads like wildfire, and the BIA Chief asks Ravi and Parvati what their next move is. The Chief asks Nadkarni to share photographs of Shafiq Rahman, Ajay Sinha and Girish Chauhan with their BIA officer in Nepal to find a connection between the three.

videos.title: Operation Tabaahi - Chapter 4
videos.overview: Ravi and his team covertly raid Jaan Mohammed's godown in Nepal, arrest him and discover a room full of counterfeit cash. Meanwhile, Parvati issues orders to activate all their agents and informants to speed up the search for the bomb's location. Will they be able to find it in time?

videos.title: Operation Aazadi - Chapter 1
videos.overview: Ravi receives a tip about a conspiracy involving the release of three people. However, his informant later dies, but not before sending Ravi a voice note with the critical information. Meanwhile, a filmmaker from the US is under surveillance. What is the connection?

videos.title: Operation Aazadi - Chapter 2
videos.overview: Ravi observes Sara Coney using sign language and directs his team to investigate the cold storage facility that exports Ghol fish. What new information will they uncover during their investigation?
